description: This file defines a report for asset depreciations and balances in ERPNext, including functions to fetch asset categories, assets, and generate report columns and data.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and processes asset data for the report.

methods.name: get_asset_categories
methods.description: Retrieves asset categories and related financial data within date range.

methods.name: get_assets
methods.description: Retrieves asset depreciation details grouped by asset category.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the report columns with labels and formatting.
